did-not-finish.pending-empty: No runner waiting for an out confirmation.
did-not-finish.catch-up-hint: Credits the next loop with a one hour time (the upper bound). The runner leaves the out list and rejoins the race.
did-not-finish.catch-up-confirm: Let {{name}} through on loop {{loop}}? Default time is one hour; the runner rejoins the race with that punch.
did-not-finish.reinstate-hint: If a runner was marked out too eagerly, or a withdrawal was recorded by mistake, one click brings them back. It credits the missed loop with a one hour time and drops the out marker.
did-not-finish.withdrawal-hint: For a runner who gives up between two loops. Records them as out at their last closed loop and removes them from the live standings.
did-not-finish.withdraw-confirm: Record {{name}} as withdrawn at loop {{loop}}? The runner leaves the live standings.
